proposals.fact: Baroness Orla of Optics is hired as Lead Courtier of Optics in the Tower of Vibes during early Book 1, practicing Illusion Magic / Buzzword Hypnosis from The Grimoire of Optics, and later orchestrates pulling the ER Watch back into Vibes by rebranding Sarai's Captain seat into Chief Steward of ER.
proposals.source_passage: Google Doc Tabs 1, 2, 3, and 4 (named in Tab 4 Showdown beat)

proposals.fact: Sir Leo, Counsel of Liability, serves under Doctor Lois in Liability Tower as Marissa's candid professional ally, warns Lois against refusing Marissa's layering severance request, takes Protected Exile in January–February, and champions bringing Marissa back on an independent consulting retainer in April.

Ziva is hired by Baroness Orla as Chief Steward of ER (starting Dec 7) to layer Marissa; she is competent at frontline ER Ops but unable to run litigation-grade legal investigations, leading to outside-counsel escalation and her resignation after 90 days in March.

Supporting castle figures include Brittany (Sales Courtier of Optics), Sienna (Engineering Courtier of Optics), Bryce (High Lord of Engineering), the Grand Treasurer of Finance, and the Silk-Robed Sellswords of Outside Counsel (managed by partner Arthur).

In Act I/II (The Fracture), Marissa completes an airtight Formal Inquiry proving an unnamed High Lord is bullying their fiefdom and recommends Okta Excommunication; Doctor Lois folds to High Table politics and pressures Marissa to downgrade the remedy to coaching.
proposals.source_passage: Google Doc Tab 4 Section 4 (Pivotal Arc Beats — The Fracture)
